title: KMS Failure-Mode Test Matrix (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) — Test Harness + Results
content:
Last updated: 2025-02-24 (post staging game-day + canary)
Owner: Rafael Mendes (SRE)
Primary goal: validate resilience when KMS dependencies degrade (timeouts/throttling/denies/outage) and ensure behavior is predictable across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private.

Legend
- Surface: CP=control plane, DP=data plane, INST=Private installer
- Env: STG=staging, CAN=canary tenant(s), PRV-STG=private staging cluster
- Result: PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL
- “Expected behavior” follows the KMS Degradation Runbook + agreed SLOs

Baseline acceptance criteria (v1)
- DP should remain available for reads when possible using cache/dual-read; writes may degrade but must be bounded.
- No infinite retries; retries must honor backoff + circuit breaker.
- Breaker open should reduce KMS QPS and protect latency.
- Clear operator signals: metrics, audit events for failures, and per-tenant impact summary.

Test harness controls (staging)
- failure_injection.enabled=true
- failure_injection.mode = timeout | throttle | access_denied | disabled_key | endpoint_unreachable | dns_nxdomain | malformed_response
- failure_injection.target = encrypt | decrypt | generate_data_key | describe_key
- failure_injection.rate = 1.0 (100%) unless noted
- failure_injection.latency_ms = injected delay for slow-KMS tests

Matrix (rows are scenarios; columns are spreadsheet-style)

ID	Scenario	Surface	Env	Provider	Injection / Steps	Expected behavior	Observed behavior (summary)	Key signals to verify	Result	Follow-up / Fix links	Notes
KMS-01	KMS encrypt timeout (5s+) during tokenization metadata write	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject timeout on Encrypt for 50% of calls	Retries with bounded backoff; breaker opens; request path should not exceed latency budget; write path returns explicit error w/ retryable classification	Breaker opened after ~30s; p99 latency spiked briefly; errors classified as retryable; no crashloops	kms_client_request_latency_ms p95/p99; breaker_state; error_class=TIMEOUT; request_latency_p99	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28741; Linear:ENG-4226	Initial spike due to breaker threshold too high; tuned in alerts doc (see KMS-13)
KMS-02	KMS decrypt timeout on hot path (artifact read)	DP	CAN	AWS KMS	Inject timeout on Decrypt for 10% calls (per-tenant)	Prefer cache; if miss, bounded retries; serve 5xx only when cannot decrypt; avoid thundering herd	Observed elevated decrypt failures (0.6% to 2.4% for ~6 min) for one canary due to cache TTL too low + concurrent misses	kms_cache_hit_rate; decrypt_error_rate; breaker_open_count; per_tenant_kms_health	PARTIAL	Slack:incidents/thread_1740846122; Linear:ENG-4239; GitHub:redwood/pr_28910	Action item: increase minimum cache TTL floor + add jitter; document mitigation toggle in runbook
KMS-03	KMS throttling (HTTP 429 / ThrottlingException)	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject throttling responses at 30% rate	Adaptive backoff; breaker should prevent sustained hammering; system should converge to stable error rate and preserve latency for non-KMS-dependent routes	Backoff worked; breaker prevented QPS runaway; overall request latency stable; error rate capped	kms_request_qps; kms_throttle_count; retry_attempts_histogram; breaker_state	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28741; Linear:ENG-4226	Need to confirm same behavior on Azure Key Vault (see KMS-16)
KMS-04	IAM AccessDenied on Decrypt (key policy removed)	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject AccessDenied for Decrypt	Classify as non-retryable; breaker should not flap; emit audit event; per-tenant health shows AccessDenied; operator runbook points to IAM policy fix	Correctly classified non-retryable; audit event emitted; per-tenant endpoint showed AccessDenied; alert fired (warning, not page)	kms_error_code=AccessDenied; audit_event=KMS_DECRYPT_FAILED; per_tenant_kms_health	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28805; GitHub:redwood/pr_28910	Docs: add screenshot of health endpoint output (restricted)
KMS-05	IAM AccessDenied on GenerateDataKey (envelope flow)	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject AccessDenied on GenerateDataKey only	Writes should fail fast; reads should continue if cache contains DEKs; clear messaging for operators	Writes failed fast; reads continued; error message included key ARN and operation (sanitized)	operation=GenerateDataKey; error_code=AccessDenied; write_fail_rate vs read_success_rate	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28805	Verify sanitization meets audit logging spec (no plaintext, no customer secrets)
KMS-06	Key disabled (DisableKey) mid-traffic	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject DisabledException for Decrypt/Encrypt	Reads should attempt dual-read where configured; otherwise fail with actionable error; breaker may open but should not hide root cause	Observed actionable error; breaker opened (expected due to elevated errors); dual-read reduced blast radius for tenants in rotation window	audit_event includes key_id; decrypt_error_code=DisabledException; dual_read_fallback_count	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28822; GitHub:redwood/pr_28805	This is our best mitigation during emergency rotation; ensure operators know to enable dual-read window before disabling old key
KMS-07	Wrong region endpoint / region outage (endpoint unreachable)	DP	PRV-STG	AWS KMS	Block egress to kms.<region>.amazonaws.com	DP should trip breaker quickly; cache should extend effective availability for reads; runbook suggests cache TTL bump + failover options	Breaker opened quickly; cache extended read availability ~18 min; after cache expired, decrypt failures increased as expected	breaker_open_time_to_open; cache_hit_rate; decrypt_fail_rate over time	PASS	Confluence:eng-sre/runbooks/kms-dependency-degradation-runbook	Private clusters need explicit egress allowlist; add to installer preflight (see KMS-12)
KMS-08	KMS DNS NXDOMAIN / intermittent resolution	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject dns_nxdomain 100% for KMS hostname	Should behave like endpoint unreachable; breaker opens; no tight retry loop	Behaved as expected; retries bounded; CPU stable	client_error_class=DNS; breaker_state; pod_cpu	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28741	Add alert on DNS errors separately (low noise)
KMS-09	Malformed KMS response / SDK decode error	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject malformed_response on Decrypt	Fail fast; classify as dependency failure; emit audit event w/ sanitized details; breaker opens if persistent	Fail fast; audit event emitted; breaker opened after threshold	kms_error_class=SDKDecode; audit_event; breaker_open_count	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28805	Rare but good to ensure it’s not retried forever
KMS-10	Config drift: key version not pinned; accidental key-version rotation in CP	CP	STG	AWS KMS	Attempt to apply config w/ key ARN missing explicit version pin (where applicable)	CP validation rejects unsafe config; migration provides clear error; no silent drift	Rejected with clear validation message; safe default enforced	cp_config_validation_errors; audit log of config change attempt	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28788; Linear:ENG-4221	Ensure docs explain version pinning semantics for customer-managed KMS
KMS-11	Rotation dual-read window: new key decrypt fails, old key succeeds	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Enable rotation mode; inject Decrypt failure for new key only	DP tries new then old (bounded); emits metric for fallback; no user-visible failures	No user-visible failures; fallback metric incremented; audit event for decrypt failure emitted (new key)	dual_read_fallback_count; decrypt_fail_by_key_id; audit_event	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28822; GitHub:redwood/pr_28805	Acceptance: bounded fallback only (no unbounded loop) verified
KMS-12	Private installer preflight: key unreachable / wrong region / missing perms	INST	PRV-STG	AWS KMS	Run installer with (a) wrong region endpoint (b) missing kms:Decrypt (c) key policy missing principal	Installer should fail preflight with actionable remediation steps; no partial install	Preflight failed with clear errors + suggested IAM statements; reduced time-to-diagnose from ~2h to ~15 min in trial	installer_preflight_status; error_detail contains missing action; link to docs	PASS	GitHub:redwood-private-installer/pr_512; GitHub:redwood-terraform/pr_934	Edge case: IAM propagation delay caused false negative once; see KMS-14
KMS-13	Alerting: slow-brownout (KMS latency p95 +200ms, error low)	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Inject +250ms latency on all KMS calls; no explicit errors	Should trigger warning alert; not page initially; dashboard shows correlation to request p99; breaker should remain closed (low error)	Warning alert fired; no page; request p99 increased but stayed under SLO for most routes; breaker remained closed	kms_latency_p95/p99; route_latency_p99; alert severity	PASS	(Drive draft) shared_drives/engineering/site-reliability-engineering/kms-alerting-review-and-tuning	Make sure on-call knows to check KMS latency dashboard before toggling breaker thresholds
KMS-14	IAM propagation delay during Private install/upgrade	INST	PRV-STG	AWS KMS	Apply IAM policy then immediately run preflight	Installer should recommend retry/backoff on preflight checks; avoid misleading “permanent deny” messaging	Observed one misleading message (treated as hard deny). Updated copy pending	preflight_error_class=TRANSIENT?; retry suggestion text	PARTIAL	GitHub:redwood-private-installer/pr_512 (follow-up commit pending); Linear:ENG-4242	Need heuristic: if AccessDenied + just-created role => suggest wait 2–5 min and retry
KMS-15	GCP KMS: throttling / quota exceeded	DP	STG	GCP KMS	Inject RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED style errors	Backoff; breaker support; consistent classification in logs/audit events	Classification inconsistent (mapped to generic “UnknownDependencyError”); breaker still opened but logs less actionable	error_code_mapping; audit_event fields; breaker_state	PARTIAL	Linear:ENG-4234 (subtask: provider error mapping); GitHub:redwood/pr_28741	Need provider-specific mapping table in code + docs
KMS-16	Azure Key Vault: 429 throttling and 503 service unavailable	DP	STG	Azure Key Vault	Inject 429 and 503 alternating	Backoff should respect Retry-After if present; breaker should avoid hammering; logs should capture status code	Retry-After header not respected; observed higher-than-necessary retries; breaker ultimately protected system	retry_delay_effective_ms; status_code=429/503; breaker_open_count	FAIL	Linear:ENG-4226 (follow-up: respect Retry-After); Linear:ENG-4234	Must fix before expanding Azure support in Private
KMS-17	Cache behavior under KMS outage: TTL extension toggle	DP	STG	AWS KMS	Simulate endpoint_unreachable; toggle cache_ttl_emergency_multiplier	Emergency toggle increases effective cache TTL; should reduce failures but must not exceed max TTL cap; emit audit/ops log for toggle	Toggle worked; decrypt failures decreased; cap enforced; ops log emitted	kms_cache_ttl_effective; decrypt_fail_rate; ops_toggle_event	PASS	Confluence:eng-sre/runbooks/kms-dependency-degradation-runbook	Need to document “when NOT to use” (e.g., suspected key compromise)
KMS-18	Audit logging completeness for KMS lifecycle + failures	DP/CP	STG	AWS KMS	Trigger: Encrypt, Decrypt fail, AccessDenied, Disabled key; CP config apply; rotation event	Audit events emitted with required schema fields; no sensitive data; correlated via request_id/tenant_id where applicable	Audit events present, but one field missing for decrypt failures (kms_provider_region) in early build	pipeline_event_count; schema validation; missing_field_rate	PARTIAL	GitHub:redwood/pr_28805 (follow-up patch needed)	Coordinate with Daniel Carter (GRC evidence) on required fields
KMS-19	Per-tenant KMS health summary endpoint correctness	DP	CAN	AWS KMS	Induce AccessDenied for one tenant, timeout for another; query admin endpoint	Endpoint should show accurate per-tenant state without leaking secrets; gated behind admin RBAC	Correct; RBAC gate verified; output sanitized; helped triage canary incident	endpoint_access_logs; rbac_denials; tenant_health_state	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28910	Add to on-call evidence checklist
KMS-20	Rotation rollback: new key introduced then reverted	CP/DP	STG	AWS KMS	Apply rotation config -> enable dual-read -> revert to old key config	Rollback should be safe; no ciphertext breakage; CP should maintain deterministic selection; DP should not cache bad key choice indefinitely	Rollback safe; deterministic selection preserved; DP cache respected TTL and converged to old key usage	key_id_usage_over_time; cp_config_version; cache_evictions	PASS	GitHub:redwood/pr_28788; GitHub:redwood/pr_28822	Document “rollback window” guidance for operators

Notes to self (Rafael)
- Add a column in next revision for “Operator action if failing” (runbook step / toggle).
- For game-day, pre-brief Support + Solutions Eng; the canary incident taught us we need a comms template + hard stop conditions.
- Ensure evidence collection steps match Olga/Daniel’s control mapping (audit logs + change mgmt + incident artifacts).
